title: Extending property tax relief for wildfire-hit properties
summary: Lahaina property tax exemptions were frozen so owners keep them as they move back, an ordinance extended relief, and Bill 144 was among pending bills to extend it. Bill 103 would move the exemption's end date from December 31, 2026 to June 30, 2028, lining up with Ordinance 5913.

timeline.text: Bill 103 changes the budget on the real property tax expiry date for wildfire-impacted properties.
Bill 103 would extend a property tax exemption for wildfire-impacted properties to June 30, 2028.
The budget director said Bill 103 updates the exemption's end date to line up with Ordinance 5913.
